name: TinyDataTable
description: Feature-rich data tables with sorting, filtering and pagination.
body: A powerful, flexible table component for complex data-heavy interfaces.
featured_features: Advanced data tables, column sorting, global search, filtering, pagination, row selection, dynamic grouping, child rows, aggregations, and AJAX data loading.

name: TinyScheduler
body: Build flexible scheduling experiences with a dedicated JavaScript component.
featured_features: Calendar views for month, week, day, and list; resource scheduling, timeline views, event management, conflict detection, and interactive planning.

name: TinyAutocomplete
description: Fast, configurable suggestion lists for inputs.
body: Make text inputs more efficient with suggestions and configurable options.
featured_features: Autocomplete suggestions, local or AJAX search, highlighted matches, keyboard navigation, custom rendering, and cancellation of outdated requests.

name: TinySelectize
body: Make advanced select fields easier to work with.
featured_features: Enhanced select controls with single or multiple selection, option search, AJAX loading, keyboard navigation, and a programmatic value-management API.

name: TinyChips
body: Manage labels and tokens in forms.
featured_features: Tag and chip management, adding and removing values, structured input, autocomplete, HTML-field synchronization, and JSON/CSV data formats.

name: TinyDatePicker
description: Flexible date picking for web interfaces.
body: Pick dates with a focused JavaScript UI.
featured_features: Single-date and date-range selection, inline/modal/persistent modes, month and year selection, event markers, localization, and light/dark themes.

name: tinyColorPicker
body: Bring intuitive color selection to your forms.
featured_features: Customizable color picker, custom palettes, light/dark themes, CSS variables for the selected color, and optional integration with TinySwal.

name: TinySignature
description: Capture handwritten signatures in the browser.
body: Capture signatures with a dedicated JavaScript component.
featured_features: Canvas signature capture, smooth Bézier strokes, mouse and touch support, undo/redo, PNG/JPEG/SVG export, and point import/export.

name: TinyTabs
description: Organize content into elegant tabbed panels.
body: Keep dense pages navigable with tabs.
featured_features: Tab navigation with associated panels, active-tab indicator, disabled tabs, keyboard navigation, swipe gestures, and a selection API.

name: TinyDropdown
body: Create clear contextual menus and dropdowns.
featured_features: Contextual dropdown menus, automatic positioning, viewport collision handling, keyboard navigation, typeahead search, and customizable actions.

name: TinySideNav
body: Build compact navigation structures.
featured_features: Left or right side navigation, animated opening/closing, touch gestures, persistent navigation mode, and optional scroll locking while open.

name: TinyCollapsible
body: Organize large information sets with collapsible panels.
featured_features: Expandable and collapsible sections, accordion mode, configurable animations, open/closed state management, callbacks, and keyboard interaction.

name: TinyGroupButton
body: Present related controls as a cohesive group.
featured_features: Grouped selection buttons, checkbox support, multiple choices, Select All option, synchronized values, and change events.

name: TinyGallery
body: Display and organize images with a reusable gallery.
featured_features: Responsive image galleries, multiple uploads, drag and drop, reordering, undoable removal, file validation, editing callbacks, and TinyLightbox integration.

name: TinyLightbox
body: Open media in a focused viewing experience.
featured_features: Full-screen image viewer, image navigation, zoom, panning, touch gestures, keyboard shortcuts, configurable transitions, and captions.

name: TinyCarousel
body: Present media and content as a compact carousel.
featured_features: Image and content carousels, 3D animations, full-width mode, multiple visible slides, navigation arrows, indicators, progress bar, and responsive configuration.

name: TinySortableList
body: Give users intuitive drag-and-drop ordering.
featured_features: Drag-and-drop reordering, mouse/touch/stylus support, keyboard movement, dynamically added items, and list order management.

name: TinyInlineEditor
body: Turn displayed content into editable fields.
featured_features: Inline text editing, rich text toolbar, HTML formatting, links, lists, colors, independent editing instances, and optional auto-save.

name: TinySwal
body: Display contextual feedback and action dialogs.
featured_features: Modal dialogs, alerts, confirmations, toasts, embedded forms, asynchronous validation, timers, progress bars, draggable windows, and custom themes.

name: TinyT
body: A focused JavaScript tool for developer workflows.
featured_features: JavaScript template engine with dynamic expressions, conditions, loops, reusable nested templates, helper functions, DOM rendering, global configuration, and optional jQuery integration.
